title: speckit verification manifest
description: The check manifest at .specify/verify.json. One invalid check rejects the whole manifest: a partially-valid manifest produces green runs over half a suite.

selection.description: Change-scoped selection. Omitted, the built-in shared-file list applies.

select_all_on.description: Globs for shared or configuration files. A change to any of them runs every check, because a file-glob selection cannot bound such a change's effect.

id.description: Unique within the manifest; appears verbatim in reports and ledger records.

runner.description: Selects the exit-code and examined-count adapter. `command` reports examined=unknown unless the command prints a parseable count.

command.description: Executed verbatim and recorded in the ledger. Must not contain a credential; pass secrets through env.

paths.description: Globs matched against the change set for selection. Used with git diff --name-only.

oracle.description: Where the expected value comes from. `implementation` (or an absent value) excludes the check from evidence with a named reason (FR-004).

control.description: A command that must FAIL. If it passes, the check is vacuous and the verdict is INCOMPLETE (FR-005).

falsify.description: For kind=property: the known-failing input that demonstrates the property can fail (FR-030). Executed before the property.

spec_rule.description: For kind=property or schema: the specification rule the check encodes (FR-029).

coverage.description: Path to a coverage.py JSON report this check contributes to the changed-line report (FR-033).

timeout_s.description: A timeout is status=fail with note=timeout, never a pass.

rules.description: Pinned, committed rule file. Absence is a refusal (exit 2), never a fetch (FR-026).

baseline.description: Per-rule counts recorded by the observe stage. The block stage refuses without it (FR-025).

confirm.description: Enables the network confirmation tier (trufflehog --only-verified). Offline reports NOT-RUN, never clean (FR-036).

extreme.description: Whole-method mutation: faster, less precise, always labelled as such (FR-039).
